name: for-women-who
description: The For Women Who theme: a faceless weekly women's magazine with a small digital shop.

accent_colour.description: The seasonal accent colour used across the whole site. One at a time.

current_issue_label.description: Shown in the black bar at the top of every page.

contact_email.description: Shown on the About page and used by the Contact link in the footer.

instagram_url.description: Full link to the Instagram profile. Leave empty to hide the link.

pinterest_url.description: Full link to the Pinterest profile. Leave empty to hide the link.

about_hero_image.description: About page header. Upload at least 2400 × 1350. No faces.

hero_image.description: Full-bleed homepage photo. Upload at least 2400 × 1350; keep the middle calm.

hero_button_link.description: Where the hero button goes, for example /issues/ or /tag/issue-01/

marquee_lines.default: For women who have places to be | For women who changed their minds | For women who care about their careers and their lipstick
marquee_lines.description: The scrolling black strip. Separate each line with a | character.

statement_text.default: A weekly magazine about work, life, taste and everything we're still *figuring* out.
statement_text.description: Wrap the one word for the oval in *asterisks*.

shop_figure_image.description: Cutout in front of THE SHOP. Transparent PNG or WebP, at least 900 × 1500.

shop_planners_image.description: Planners tile in the black shop strip. About 4:5, at least 800 × 1000.

shop_journals_image.description: Journals tile in the black shop strip. About 4:5, at least 800 × 1000.

shop_magazine_image.description: The Magazine tile in the black shop strip. About 4:5, at least 800 × 1000.

shop_wallpapers_image.description: Wallpapers tile in the black shop strip. About 4:5, at least 800 × 1000.
